summary_en: This phase 1b study tests JNJ-90301900, injected directly into tumors, together with chemotherapy and radiation therapy in people with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. JNJ-90301900 is given by injection into the tumor and/or lymph node, along with cisplatin, or carboplatin with paclitaxel, and intensity-modulated radiation therapy; how long and how often are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated, and the registry lists this study as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa JNJ-90301900, inyectado directamente en los tumores, junto con quimioterapia y radioterapia en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello localmente avanzado. JNJ-90301900 se administra por inyección en el tumor o en el ganglio linfático, junto con cisplatino, o carboplatino con paclitaxel, y radioterapia de intensidad modulada; la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica, y el registro clasifica este estudio como fase 1.
who_for: Squamous cell cancer of the oral cavity, hypopharynx, supraglottic larynx, or p16-negative oropharynx
Stage III, IVA, or IVB disease under AJCC 8th edition
Candidate for definitive concurrent chemoradiation as judged by the investigator
At least one measurable target lesion (primary tumor or involved lymph node) per RECIST 1.1
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, and age 18 to 74 years
not_for: Tumor starting in the nasopharynx, paranasal sinuses, salivary glands, thyroid, parathyroid, skin, or unknown primary site
Stage 0, I, II, or IVC disease, recurrent disease, or a second primary within 2 months
Known or suspected allergy or hypersensitivity to JNJ-90301900 or its excipients
